semiconductor_relevance: High — SET Corporation SA specializes in high-precision Flip-Chip Bonders and Nanoimprint Lithography solutions, which are critical for semiconductor assembly processes.
summary: SET Corporation SA is a leading supplier of high-accuracy Flip-Chip Bonders and versatile Nanoimprint Lithography solutions, catering to laboratories and industries in the semiconductor sector. Their equipment is renowned for its sub-micron accuracy and reliability in component assembly, making them a key player in the semiconductor manufacturing landscape.

regional_presence.France: SET Corporation SA is based in France and has a global network of representatives and customer training programs.
